subject: FINDING: PanelEngine peer-role cache makes remap rendering order-dependent
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-performance-rd-panel-role-remap-coherence-20261002. CONFIRMED_BY_SOURCE: FoldOverlayService supplies hasLiveInnerElsewhere by reading peer PanelEngine.innerPanel caches; PanelEngine.evaluate() refreshes only self.innerPanel from current Display geometry before tilt selection; engines are processed sequentially. Therefore a logical-ID physical-panel role swap can make the first newly-cover engine see the peer's stale pre-remap COVER role. DuoShader makes the branch materially different: at hinge=150deg normal cover tilt=89.5/max while concurrent-cover tilt=0 because >=135deg cutoff. Gen3 Alpha1 scripts do not alter this peer-role callback. HYPOTHESIS_DEVICE=on Fold7, if both built-in engines are live through the remap while autonomous/fallback PanelEngine rendering is eligible, this can flash/start an incorrect frost phase for the first pass. Independent from privileged mirror/lease ownership.
